name: Cork Medical
old_description: that specializes in designing and manufacturing innovative products for the treatment and prevention of wounds. The company products consist of Negative Pressure Wound Therapy, Specialty Mattresses, Overlays, and Cushions and are sold across the world.
about:
Cork Medical was founded in 2007 in Indianapolis, Indiana, by a team of founders who set out to improve lives through innovative wound care solutions. The company began as a distributor of negative pressure wound therapy (NPWT) devices and specialty mattresses before evolving into a manufacturer with its own clinical and engineering teams.

Today, Cork Medical designs and manufactures the Nisus NPWT System, specialty mattresses, overlays, and wheelchair cushions. The company’s product development is driven by clinician input, resulting in what it describes as one of the industry’s most reliable and powerful NPWT platforms. Its products are sold worldwide.

The company serves healthcare institutions including hospitals, nursing homes, long-term care facilities, and homecare agencies, as well as distributors seeking cost-effective NPWT solutions. Cork Medical identifies as a medical device and support surface manufacturer.

Cork Medical’s stated mission is to improve lives through innovative wound care products, with a vision to become a leading global manufacturer in the field. The company cites its ISO 13485:2016 certification and clinician-driven product development as key differentiators.
